mainEntity.name: How can I prepare my property for a deck rebuilding project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before your deck rebuilding project begins, clearing the area around the existing deck is helpful. Remove any furniture, planters, grills, or other personal items. If there are plants or landscaping close to the deck, consider temporarily relocating them or protecting them from construction debris. Ensuring clear access for our crew and materials can also help streamline the process. This preparation minimizes delays and helps the project start smoothly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare for deck rebuilding by clearing the existing deck area of furniture and personal items, and protecting nearby landscaping. This helps ensure smooth project commencement.
